Bridge validation — 2026-10-19

Scripts/build-bridge.sh was run from a clean generated module layout with:
  --developer-dir /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer
  --sdk iphonesimulator --deployment-target 26.0
and separately:
  --developer-dir /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer
  --sdk iphoneos --deployment-target 26.0

Both generated SwiftUICore modules compiled and the real-system link probes passed.
Xcode/SDK: 27.0. Compiler: Apple Swift 6.4.
The script pins DEVELOPER_DIR and SDKROOT for child compiler/linker commands, so
an unrelated active xcode-select configuration does not choose a different linker SDK.

Mach-O LC_BUILD_VERSION of the probes:
- arm64-apple-ios26.0-simulator: platform 7 (IOSSIMULATOR), minos 26.0, sdk 27.0
- arm64-apple-ios26.0:           platform 2 (IOS),          minos 26.0, sdk 27.0

nm -u confirmed imports of:
  _$s7SwiftUI27AppearanceAnimationStrategyO04withD0yA2CmFWC
  _$s7SwiftUI27AppearanceAnimationStrategyOMa
  _$s7SwiftUI4ViewPAAE19appearanceAnimation9animation8strategy8modifierQrAA0E0V_AA010AppearanceE8StrategyOqd__x_SbtXEtAaBRd__lF
  _$s7SwiftUI4ViewPAAE19appearanceAnimation9animation8strategy8modifierQrAA0E0V_AA010AppearanceE8StrategyOqd__x_SbtXEtAaBRd__lFQOMQ
otool -L identified the actual system SwiftUI framework dependency.

Device SDK public declarations were sourced from Apple's arm64e textual interface
and compiled for arm64, because this SDK does not ship a separate arm64 interface.
Device success here means compilation and linkage only. No iPhone execution was done.
The runtime behavior demonstrated by the containing investigation is iOS 27.2 arm64
Simulator, across app, Home Widget, Live Activity Lock Screen and expanded Dynamic Island.

Generated manifests record local source hashes, compiler, SDK, target, and include
paths. Those generated artifacts are intentionally excluded from redistribution.
